info.title: Screeps World and OpenScreeps HTTP API
info.summary: Source-derived contracts with explicit server compatibility
info.description: Community-maintained HTTP contracts, not an official Screeps specification. Coverage is pinned to sources.json and coverage.json. Each operation declares x-availability and cites source evidence. A supported marker means the pinned implementation or reference client documents the operation, not that every operation was exercised live. Shapes shared by differing implementations are unions; read x-compatibility and descriptions before using a server-specific field. WebSocket/SockJS channels and the in-game JavaScript API are not HTTP operations and are outside this document. Never infer gameplay success from HTTP 200: inspect error and ok. Endpoints can have destructive effects; specification examples are not authorization to invoke them.

servers.description: Official Screeps World; shard query/body fields route shard-specific operations.
OpenScreeps standalone server; configure host and port for your deployment. Check x-availability before calling.

host.description: Your standalone server hostname or IP address.

externalDocs.description: Pinned source provenance, coverage and compatibility policy

Token.name: X-Token
Token.description: Official API token or server-issued session token. OpenScreeps refreshes successful authenticated responses in X-Token; preserve rotated tokens. Never send tokens to untrusted hosts or follow authenticated cross-host redirects.

Bearer.description: OpenScreeps player-session alternative to X-Token. Do not assume official servers accept it.

AdminToken.description: OpenScreeps administrator secret (at least 32 characters), distinct from all player tokens. Disabled unless SCREEPS_ADMIN_TOKEN is configured.

Shard.name: shard
Shard.description: Official shard routing where the operation accepts it. OpenScreeps serves one world; this field does not select a different world.

ServerPassword.name: X-Server-Password
ServerPassword.description: Required by OpenScreeps ApiGuard routes only when the host configures SERVER_PASSWORD; independent of player authentication. Missing/wrong value returns the API error envelope, usually HTTP 200.

LegacyUsername.name: X-Username
LegacyUsername.description: Legacy Screeps API clients send the token value here as well as X-Token. OpenScreeps does not require this header.

ServerError.description: Server failed to process the request.

Success.description: Success or a logical API failure; inspect the body even when HTTP status is 200.

JsonValue.description: Arbitrary JSON value deliberately unconstrained (for example user-owned Memory).
